title: "Count Cite"
format: html
bibliography: references.bib
filters:
  - gallimaufry
extensions:
  gallimaufry:
    count-cite: true
---

## Citation counting

This filter counts how many times each citation key appears and logs the totals to the Quarto console.
Check the terminal output after rendering for a `[gallimaufry] count-cite:` log line.

Knuth wrote The TeXbook [@knuth1984], while Lamport created LaTeX [@lamport1994].
Both works are foundational to the TeX ecosystem [@knuth1984; @lamport1994].
Turing's seminal paper [@turing1936] predates them both.
